result.keywords: AbstractA hybrid methodology is proposed to improve the reliability assessment of two-phase degradation systems when the change point is uncertain and expert judgments are imprecise. The framework combines heuristic linear programming with triangular intuitionistic fuzzy numbers to derive feasible priority rankings for critical failure modes and intervention actions. A Wiener-process degradation model is used to represent the evolving system condition, while Spearman correlation is applied to evaluate the stability of the resulting rankings. A numerical case study demonstrates that the proposed approach produces consistent and robust safety decisions compared with conventional probabilistic methods, particularly when the available data are sparse and subjective assessments are ambiguous.
result.title: A hybrid reliability assessment framework for two-phase degradation systems using intuitionistic fuzzy optimization
